hero.title: A room-by-room plan for moving home.
hero.intro: Coordinate packing, access, transport and placement through one clear moving sequence.

media.alt: Illustrated moving truck beside prepared packing boxes

overview.title: Keep every handoff understandable.
overview.body: Home moving involves more than the journey between addresses. The plan connects access, packing priorities, room labels and destination placement so each stage has a clear purpose.

points.text: Agree access and timing before moving day
Match preparation to the rooms and belongings involved
Confirm placement priorities at the destination

included.title: What the moving plan can include.
included.intro: The final scope is agreed around the needs of the move.

items.title: Access planning
items.description: Review entrances, stairs, lifts and loading points before the move begins.

items.title: Protective preparation
items.description: Prepare furniture and boxed belongings for the agreed handling sequence.

items.title: Coordinated transport
items.description: Keep loading, travel and unloading connected to one practical schedule.

items.title: Room placement
items.description: Use room labels and destination priorities to support a clear final handoff.

process.title: A practical sequence from plan to placement.
process.intro: Each stage prepares the next one.

steps.title: Confirm the scope
steps.description: Outline what is moving, the access at both addresses and the target timing.

steps.title: Prepare the rooms
steps.description: Pack and label belongings according to the agreed room-by-room plan.

steps.title: Coordinate the move
steps.description: Manage loading, transport and unloading as one connected handoff.

steps.title: Place and review
steps.description: Position items in destination rooms and review the agreed scope before completion.

items.title: Office relocation
items.description: A structured handoff for workplace equipment, access and room priorities.

items.title: Home moving
items.description: Return to the complete home-moving scope and preparation sequence.

finalAction.title: Build a clear plan for moving day.
finalAction.body: Share the addresses, timing and rooms involved so the next step is understandable.
